itsmemeworks-adhx-adhx.description: Search your own ADHX saves (posts kept from X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and more) by meaning, including what is in pictures and videos, and fetch any X/Twitter post as clean LLM-friendly JSON. Use when the user asks to find something they saved, bookmarked or watched ("find my saved videos with a frog in them", "that article I saved about sleep", "the TikTok with the guy building a boat"), or shares an x.com or twitter.com post link (or a link to a post on their ADHX) and wants to read, analyze or summarize it.
